# function: kinesis_consumer

Builds the ARN of an `kinesis` `consumer`:

```
arn:${Partition}:kinesis:${Region}:${Account}:${StreamType}/${StreamName}/consumer/${ConsumerName}:${ConsumerCreationTimpstamp}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
kinesis_consumer(stream_type string, stream_name string, consumer_name string, consumer_creation_timpstamp string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `stream_type` (String) Value for `${StreamType}` in the ARN template.
1. `stream_name` (String) Value for `${StreamName}` in the ARN template.
1. `consumer_name` (String) Value for `${ConsumerName}` in the ARN template.
1. `consumer_creation_timpstamp` (String) Value for `${ConsumerCreationTimpstamp}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
